The structure of Pr₂Sb₃ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mcm (No. 140), with a unit cell containing 20 atoms—8 Pr and 12 Sb—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Pr centers with 10 geometric neighbors (4 Pr, 6 Sb) and Sb centers with 12 neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement. Polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among the 12-vertex Sb coordination polyhedra, while Pr and Sb polyhedra share corners and edges.
